propositions: The resolved_statuses config keys (jira.resolved_statuses and reconciler.resolved_statuses) have no active readers after task f020 removed the inbound probe port and its classify_probe_response function
The resolved_statuses keys were live and behaviour-affecting in shipped release v0.10.1 via adapters/jira/probe.py but became inert by v0.11.0, making hard removal a user-visible upgrade hazard
Both keys must be registered as scheduled deprecations with empty replacement, still parsing and validating identically, while emitting a registered warning naming removal release v1.0.0
The write-only DC transport plumbing (ReconcilerConfig param, JiraDataCenterSettings field, DEFAULT_RESOLVED_STATUSES constant, backend.py kwarg) must be removed as behaviour-neutral cleanup
Documentation in config.md and user-guide.md must be updated to describe both keys as deprecated, warning, and scheduled for removal tracked on follow-up ticket
A follow-up hard-removal ticket must be filed requiring operator sign-off for tombstone-class removal, consistent with the code_health.enabled precedent
